moments.text: Grey-scale infrared view with a centre crosshair over a streaky grey background. A short bright streak just right of the crosshair moves off to the upper right.
A faint light streak crosses from the right side down past the crosshair toward the bottom.
A small bright spot rises from the lower left, passes just below the crosshair and climbs to the top edge at upper right.
A second small bright spot enters at the bottom edge and slides left along the bottom, leaving at the lower left.
A bright spot drops in at the top right and moves down-right into the upper-right black box.
A bright spot with a faint tail enters at the top and moves diagonally down to the left edge.
A bright spot with a faint tail enters at the left, reaches the crosshair, then swings up and down through the crosshair several times.
